free_tier.stated: 100 free minutes of 2 parallel web+mobile automation testing, valid for lifetime, on all browsers and OS for selenium, playwright, puppeteer, cypress or JavaScript based automation tests. The Live Testing freemium plan separately gives 5 free sessions of up to 2 minutes each on real devices every month; no credit card required.
free_tier.notes: the 100 automation minutes are a one-time lifetime allowance, not a monthly pool; the real-device live sessions (5 x 2 minutes per month) do renew monthly but are interactive live sessions, not automation capacity

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a hosted test device session, not a stored object

retention.stated: Test execution data on the VM or real device is deleted as soon as the test completes; logs, videos and screenshots generated during a test are stored encrypted for 30 days by default.
retention.notes: section 4 Information Retention of the privacy policy states both the immediate deletion of execution state and the 30-day default for logs, videos and screenshots

egress.terms: not published on the pages read: the pricing page and privacy policy state no separate egress allowance or price per TB for device sessions

interface_detail: Automation Cloud driven by Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Puppeteer and Appium, Espresso and XCUITest against real iOS and Android devices; a Lambda Tunnel reaches locally hosted apps; REST APIs and SDKs for pipelines.
tooling: Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Puppeteer, Appium, Espresso and XCUITest suites via hosted grids; REST APIs including a Screenshot API; CI integrations with GitHub, GitLab and CircleCI; Lambda Tunnel for private apps; no shell-level device access or rclone backend.
chaining: A hosted real-device cloud for running mobile and web test suites in CI without owning handsets; the 100 lifetime minutes size a first suite, and at scale the Real Device Plus Automation Cloud tier is USD 199 a month billed annually for one parallel device, billed by concurrency rather than by minutes.

identity_cost.detail: The registration page offers 'Work email' with Continue, or 'Continue with Google' and 'Continue with Github'; no card, phone number, ID document or institution is asked for at signup, and the pricing page FAQ states 'no credit card required' for the free plan.

reliability_note: VMs and real devices are cleaned between runs: test execution data is deleted as soon as a test completes and a device is returned to the public pool only after cleanup; generated logs, videos and screenshots expire after 30 days by default.
confidence_note: The free minutes, the USD 199 real-device automation tier, the signup gate and the retention period were read from first-party TestMu AI pricing, registration and privacy pages on 2026-11-25.

notes: A hosted real-device cloud for web and mobile app automation: Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Puppeteer and Appium, Espresso and XCUITest tests run on physical iOS and Android devices. The free plan gives 100 lifetime minutes with 2 parallel sessions; the paid Real Device Plus Automation Cloud tier is USD 199 a month billed annually for one parallel real device, which the operator's list converts to USD 0.273/h over 730 hours. No general-purpose shell VM is offered; the compute is a managed device session. Formerly branded LambdaTest; the company states it rebranded to TestMu AI on 2026-01-12.
